Fix `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. REGRESSION in an existing test that passed before this run. Do not change that test.
FAIL packages/excalidraw/tests/stickyNotes.test.tsx > sticky notes > editing > routes a top pick to the label and the sticky default while editing a note
AssertionError: expected '#1e1e1e' to be '#e03131' // Object.is equality
 ❯ packages/excalidraw/tests/stickyNotes.test.tsx:604:48

Cause: opening an existing element for editing auto-selects all its text (textWysiwyg.tsx:1321, `editable.select()`), so getTextEditorSelection returns a non-empty selection before the user selects anything, and actionChangeStrokeColor takes the range path instead of setting strokeColor. Fix in actionChangeStrokeColor only: a selection covering the whole text counts as no selection there, and falls through to today's element path. Concretely, in perform, before calling applyStyleToEditorSelection, read `const editing = appState.editingTextElement; const selection = editing ? getTextEditorSelection(app.ownerDocument) : null;` and find the current scene element for editing.id in `elements`; when it is a text element and `selection.start === 0 && selection.end === element.originalText.length`, skip applyStyleToEditorSelection so the existing code below runs. Add a short comment saying the editor selects all text when it opens, so a whole-text selection means the element, not a range. Do not change applyStyleToEditorSelection, actionChangeTextHighlight or actionResetTextStyle: highlight and reset still apply to a whole-text selection.
